implementation: First native audit: locate grid mesh actor by exact mesh path; record transform, mesh hash, overrides, material slots, collision and baseline exterior/plaza screenshots. Record wall footprint component selection before extracting anything.

Create a separate original Kotel detail assembly in a new review namespace. Extract or reproduce only component7085 under frozen bounds, keeping the other eight grid components and original grid asset recoverable; avoid coincident hidden base faces/z-fighting. Root must approve extraction plan before geometry work.

Create an original course layout as editable per-course/per-block data from reference observation. Large long lower dressed stones, unequal widths and offset joints, transitional upper courses and smaller top masonry must read as distinct bands. Exact course elevations, stone counts across face and individual widths remain unsurveyed; mark approximated values explicitly rather than procedurally inventing historical precision.

Use real shallow beveled geometry for visible block edges and recessed drafted margins on close approach; reserve normal detail for pores/tooling. Localized chipped corners and rounded wear, sparse cracks and restrained darker joint pockets; no uniform ruin damage, black grid grout or identical noisily bulging stones.

Author original warm ivory/beige/pale gray variation tied to individual stone identity, with restrained correlated roughness and fine porous normals. Keep sun shading out of base color; low metallic, nonplastic response. Reuse StoneV2 shader techniques only after visual inspection, not its uniform100x50cm course pattern.

Keep current wall patina distinct from fresh maintained new Temple stone. Add sparse localized vegetation emerging from demonstrated joints only as separate editable detail; no blanket moss or indiscriminate vines. Papers/notes are tiny optional original props with no readable personal contents.

Coordinate with platform/plaza lane: preserve recognizable western prayer face and open plaza approach. Platform must meet the back/interior side with supported levels; stairs and entrance require capsule/continuous walking tests. Removal of Al-Aqsa in this user-directed virtual scenario belongs to separate identified asset subset; do not remove this shared Kotel grid or unrelated buildings.
